annotations.text:
ROUND 1 — static mockup for review. No Flutter code touched yet.

Colours, borders, text colours and geometry were sampled pixel-by-pixel from reference.png. Planet + dunes are the real artwork cropped from that same file.

Hero "Learn 12 words today" replaces Main Skill: this block currently lives in the Profile screen (profile_screen.dart:1544) and moves to Home. Tapping it opens the word list (next artboard). Profile no longer carries it.

Figures are samples; real providers on implementation: name/avatar (myProfileProvider), streak + words + pronunciation score + practice time (stats_repository), today's words (dailyWordsControllerProvider).

MISSING: Lv 8 / 420 XP — the app has no Level-XP system yet, it must be built.

Greeting follows device clock: Good morning / afternoon / evening / night.
